Ayushmann Khurrana told reporters that his character in the upcoming satire Udta Teer will chant “Pakistan Zindabad” while portraying an amnesiac Pakistani spy, adding that he delivers the line because “I do whatever the script demands.”

During the Udta Teer trailer launch, Khurrana also reflected on co‑actor Mukul Dev, remarking that the veteran was “sadly underutilised” despite his involvement in the film.

The released trailer reunites Khurrana with Sara Ali Khan and positions the movie as an espionage satire, with Khurrana’s role depicted as a memory‑lost Pakistani operative.
